about: Groups one part of a page under its own heading, with the controls that act on that part. The section is a landmark named by its title. A section measures its own width and folds its actions below 40rem, or below 48rem when annotated.

annotated.about: The header renders in a column beside the card, as a settings page lays out a form beside its explanation. The body and the footer form the card, and the actions sit under the description. Below 48rem the header renders above the card, as the copy at a phone's width shows.
annotated.title: Annotated, the header beside the body

billing.about: Where the invoices go, and what the next one is for.
billing.title: Billing

digest.about: Once a day, everything that happened.
digest.name: Digest

failures.about: A run that fails, the moment it does.
failures.name: Failures

danger.about: Everything in it goes with it, and nothing comes back. Members lose their access at once.
danger.owner: Only an owner can do this.
danger.title: Delete this workspace

folding.about: The same card at two widths. The section folds when its own width is under 40rem. An action with an icon then shows the icon alone, the primary action keeps its solid fill, and the plain action moves into the menu at the end of the row. The list in the body runs to the card's edges.
folding.title: Wide and folded

keys.about: What a script uses to sign in as this workspace.
keys.title: API keys

members.about: Everyone with a login, and what each of them may do. An owner can change any of it.
members.title: Members

notifications.about: Which of them reach you, and how.
notifications.title: Notifications

profile.about: What the workspace is called and where it runs.
profile.title: Profile

rename.about: Shown in the sidebar, and on every invitation sent from here.
rename.title: Workspace name

settings.about: The page body stacks plain sections. Each section has a title, a line under it and its content, with its actions at the end of the title's row, and a hairline separates two plain sections. The last is a card, which raises the one thing on the page that should not be pressed by accident.
settings.title: A settings page

size.about: Each size sets the title and the description one size smaller than itself, the actions one button size smaller, and the gaps between the bands. A section takes the size of the page it is on unless it states its own.
size.title: Sizes

title: Section

variant.about: A section raised as a card pads its bands and separates its footer with a hairline. A body told to bleed drops its padding, so a list runs to the card's edges with its own rules between the rows.
variant.title: As cards

workspace.about: What it is called, who is in it, and what reaches you.
workspace.title: Workspace
